assertions.assertion: Says there is no automated migration and to rehearse on a production-like copy
assertions.rationale: States no automated or in-place migration and to rehearse on production-like copy.

assertions.assertion: Migrates configuration through the admin APIs (not direct writes), importing scopes and identity resources before resources and clients
assertions.rationale: Imports through admin APIs never direct writes, scopes and identity resources first.

assertions.assertion: Explains EF secrets are one-way hashes and must be re-provisioned from a secure source or rotated, not imported as plaintext
assertions.rationale: Explains EF secrets are one-way hashes, not to import as plaintext; re-provision from vault or rotate.

assertions.assertion: Recommends a controlled reset of operational data (grants, refresh/reference tokens, sessions) because there is no supported transfer tool, noting users must re-authenticate
assertions.rationale: Recommends controlled reset of operational data in maintenance window; users re-authenticate.

assertions.assertion: Mentions signing key continuity so JWT access tokens issued before cutover remain valid, and not removing old validation keys until tokens expire
assertions.rationale: Says JWT tokens stay valid with signing key continuity and not to remove old validation keys until tokens expire.

assertions.assertion: Recommends keeping the EF database read-only as a rollback path and not dual-writing
assertions.rationale: Keep EF DB read-only for rollback and don't dual-write.
